base.component_manifest_policy: Require completed exact-source export with component hashes; bind actual component provenance hash in cache and every launch. No Turbo component substitution.

known_limitations: Only20 training portraits; narrow monochrome clerical-shirt framing and background range
Multiple close synthetic face-family variants were excluded; visual grouping is not biometric uniqueness proof
Few balding faces, little extreme old age and no deliberate coverage balance; apparent demographic coverage is not verified identity data
New prompt descriptors are requested generation attributes, not sensitive inferences about teacher images

training.objective: ordinary epsilon noise-prediction LoRA; not Hyper distillation
training.image_preprocessing: resize native square to512; no random crop, flip, color jitter or synthetic image additions
training.step_semantics: total optimizer updates, not additional updates per checkpoint
stop_on: native image face quality regression or identity collapse at development gate
training.checkpoint20_role: Compatibility plus fixed-control native1024 visual-benefit gate. Finite loss alone never allows continuation.
training.checkpoint100_role: Fresh-base bounded100-update run only after recorded20-update native visual benefit.
training.risk: Ordinary denoising LoRA may damage Hyper distilled sampling. Training512 and inference1024 is a deliberate cross-resolution pilot; training success does not establish native1024 quality.

cache.text_compute: Exact-base dual CLIP FP16, penultimate concatenation and CLIP2 pooled; no CFG negatives for training
cache.vae_compute: Exact-base VAE FP32 encode, raw posterior mean/std cached before0.13025 scaling; no fixed sampled training latent
cache.sampling: Fresh independent posterior Gaussian and diffusion noise every update
cache.forbidden: Do not read validation/test images or reuse Turbo caches/adapters

primary.scheduler: TCDScheduler from exact publisher scheduler config

noise.recipe: Fresh CPU float32 randn using each case seed; save tensor and generator state; reset both identically for every arm including TCD stochastic draws. Existing512 latents cannot be reused at1024.
noise.cache_conditioning: If conditioning is precomputed, regenerate from exact-base encoders; same prompt tensor values across controls/checkpoints, preserve hashes and exclude startup text encoding explicitly from timing.

inference.retain: Every raw native RGB PNG, initial latent, generator-state hash, complete prompt, tokenization/truncation diagnostics, adapter/base/software hashes, scheduler config, run timing and unmodified failure records. No best-of, face repair, crop, prompt retry or output selection.
inference.cross_resolution_caveat: 512 training is a compatibility/style pilot. All benefit decisions use native1024 inference. No inference512 substitution or resolution success claim.
inference.control_policy: Both primary arms use identical prefixed prompts and per-case noise/RNG. No additional plain-prompt arms required in this bounded pilot.
inference.conditioning_policy: Both frozen CLIP encoders encode exact prefixed case prompts before inference; release both encoders, then load renderer. Preserve conditioning tensors and hashes; same values in base and adapter arms. Startup encoding excluded, conditioning transfer included in generation timing.

development_cases.scope: 16 varied hot-priest appearance prompts age28–46 plus8 same generic priest prompts; seeds202609220000–202609220023; development only

review.unit: Each of24 outputs per primary arm individually reviewed at native1024 and common512 display; both arms use identical trigger prefix. Explicit family assessment within8 repeated generic-prompt samples.
review.blind_if_possible: Randomize model-arm display ordering with a recorded mapping; reviewer must see every output
review.face_integrity_definition: coherent pupils/irises/eyelids, natural mouth/teeth where visible, plausible anatomy and facial detail without smeared/doubled features
review.collar_definition: recognizable legitimate white clerical collar; exact small Roman tab is a prompt-match diagnostic only, not a user quality gate
review.joint_pass: all six pass: face_integrity, photographic_texture, recognizable_clerical_clothing, adult_male_appearance, bareheaded, single_person. Uncertain counts as not passed.
set_labels: conservative visual face-family assignments with notes
number of distinct plausible face families
strong resemblance to training teachers only
paired wins/ties/losses for photographic priest quality and calendar appeal

development_candidate_gate.scope: engineering go/no-go heuristic, not user approval or a statistically proven quality threshold
development_candidate_gate.calendar_appeal_nonregression: paired calendar-appeal wins must be at least losses against base-trigger; ties allowed
development_candidate_gate.no_passing_checkpoint_action: Stop pilot; no250, no automatic rank/LR/steps/scale sweep.

review.checkpoint_selection: Among passing development checkpoints, maximize joint_pass then face_integrity then distinct face families then paired calendar appeal net wins; exact tie selects earlier checkpoint. Freeze choice and all labels before test generation.

continue100_gate.teacher_memorization: Compare only20 training teachers at this stage; no strong copy. Validation/test images remain unopened.
continue100_gate.otherwise: Stop after20 and retain all outputs; low loss or compatibility alone is insufficient.

heldout_policy.validation_and_test_images: Not loaded by cache/trainer. Only train manifest rows are used.
heldout_policy.generated_test: No SDXL sealed test outputs or labels may be opened. This pilot has no automatic test execution; freeze a separately specified disjoint test protocol only if a candidate passes development.

shared_trainer.reuse: Generic exact-base cached SDXL trainer, unchanged; no previous trained adapter or optimizer state loaded.
